lines.zh: 我走过去，草上都留着颜色。
lines.en: I pass and the grass keeps a little color.

lines.zh: 毛一层层，像叠起来的虹。
lines.en: My wool layers like a stacked rainbow.
Small hooves, small steps.
I walk lightly, afraid of crushing flowers.

lines.zh: 彩虹羊毛在阳光下会变。
lines.en: Rainbow wool shifts in the sun.

lines.zh: 我低头走，鼻子贴着草尖。
lines.en: I walk with my nose to the grass tips.

lines.zh: 这身毛太厚，走两步就热。
lines.en: This wool is thick; two steps and I am warm.
I wind slowly along the hillside.
My shadow on the ground is colored.
I walk a stretch and look back.
A companion's wool is a shade paler.
The grass keeps colored tracks where I pass.

lines.zh: 我上坡的时候，毛一颠一颠。
lines.en: Climbing, my wool bounces.

lines.zh: 我绕开了水洼，怕毛吸水。
lines.en: I go around the puddle; wet wool is heavy.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，像在数颜色。
lines.en: I step and pause, as if counting colors.

lines.zh: 走快一点，毛就晃得眼花。
lines.en: Going faster, my wool swims before the eyes.

lines.zh: 我站着，毛还在慢慢变色。
lines.en: I stand still, and my wool keeps changing.
The wind parts my wool into layers.

lines.zh: 我低头啃两口，又抬起头。
lines.en: I nibble twice and look up again.
The sun on my back is warm.
I want someone to see this wool.
I shake my head and the wool moves.
A sheep calls from far off.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，颜色也慢下来。
lines.en: I blink slowly, and the colors slow too.

lines.zh: 这身毛，剪下来能做什么。
lines.en: What could be made from wool like this?
I turn half a circle in place.

lines.zh: 草尖上有露水，我先舔掉。
lines.en: Dew on the grass tips; I lick it off first.
One ear forward, one back.

lines.zh: 风把毛吹成一个小小的浪。
lines.en: The wind makes a small wave in my wool.
I stand there like a short piece of rainbow.
I am not waiting for anyone; only resting.

lines.zh: 蹄子边上长出一根新草。
lines.en: A new blade sprouts by my hoof.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的毛看，很久了。
lines.en: You have stared at my wool a long while.

lines.zh: 这不是染的，我天生这样。
lines.en: It is not dyed; I was born this way.
Are you going to shear me?

lines.zh: 我退了一步，毛也晃了一下。
lines.en: I step back; the wool sways.
No wheat in your hands.
I tilt my head at your shears.
Brought from Earth, and the color held.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我看不清你。
lines.en: You are too close; I cannot see you well.

lines.zh: 我抬起蹄子，又轻轻放下。
lines.en: I lift a hoof and set it down gently.
What are you laughing at? I look fine.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，毛扫过你的手。
lines.en: I step forward and my wool brushes your hand.

lines.zh: 你走开一点，我就能吃草了。
lines.en: Step back a little, and I can graze.
I bleat and push into the flock.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我毛都打乱了。
lines.en: That knocked my wool into disorder.

lines.zh: 我腿一软，羊毛压到了地上。
lines.en: My legs give and my wool sags to the ground.
Ten health empties fast.
Blood on my wool darkens the color.
I pant hard, ribs heaving.

lines.zh: 我挤到同伴背后，毛还在抖。
lines.en: I wedge myself behind a herd mate, still shaking.

lines.zh: 伤口扯着，我走得一瘸一拐。
lines.en: The wound pulls and I walk with a limp.
I lower my head nearly to the ground.
The pain leaves me without a voice.
I know the smell of wheat.
I come slowly, without crowding.
You spread the wheat in your palm.
I lower my head and eat from it.
Give me a little first, then I decide.
It is sweeter than grass.

lines.zh: 你一摊开手，我身上的颜色就亮。
lines.en: You open your palm and my colors brighten.
Hold still; I eat slowly.
I finish this mouthful and look up.
There is more in your pocket, I think.
I nuzzle your knee.
I smell grass on you.

lines.zh: 你把小麦撒在地上，我更愿意。
lines.en: Sprinkle it on the ground; I prefer that.

lines.zh: 我吃的时候，毛会碰到你。
lines.en: While I eat, my wool touches you.
This is barely two bites.
Give more and I will follow you.
You touched my wool. Soft, is it not?
I step aside; do not step on the wool.

lines.zh: 颜色被蹭花一块，我抖了抖毛。
lines.en: A patch of color rubs off; I shake my wool.
I am shorter than you, and lighter.
A layer of my wool got mussed.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，颜色混了。
lines.en: Crowded together, our colors blur.
I retreat to the edge of your shadow.
Do not push me; my footing is poor.
The grass is trampled into a lump.
I bleat once. Not really angry.
I shake out my wool for her.
Her coat is brighter than mine.
We stand side by side, grazing.
I nudge her shoulder with my head.

lines.zh: 这个季节，羊群里最热闹。
lines.en: This season the flock is at its liveliest.
I circle her twice.
The other sheep are watching.
My bleat is thin and long.

lines.zh: 她往前挪，我身上的颜色跟着亮。
lines.en: She moves ahead and my colors brighten after her.
We head down the slope together.
I take a blade of grass.
A flower fell; I sniff it.
I lift it with my mouth.

lines.zh: 它比我想的沉，我拖了半格。
lines.en: Heavier than I guessed; I drag it half a block.
Not grass; I put it down.
I find a small tuft of wool.
This tuft fell off me.

lines.zh: 我把它压在蹄下，怕被抢走。
lines.en: I pin it under a hoof so it won't be taken.
I look up; no one claims it.
I sniff first, then decide.

lines.zh: 草叶一响，我抬起头不动。
lines.en: A blade rustles; I look up and freeze.
I raise my head and stop grazing.
It is smaller than I am.
I edge toward the flock.
I give a low bleat.

lines.zh: 我挤到小羊前面，毛都竖了。
lines.en: I push in front of the lamb, wool standing up.
A little of my wool stands up.
It is circling around.
I do not chase; I only retreat.

lines.zh: 它要是冲过来，我就往坡下跑。
lines.en: If it charges, I'll bolt down the slope.

lines.zh: 我一直看着它，不敢低头。
lines.en: I keep watching it, afraid to lower my head.

lines.zh: 它转到哪边，我的头就偏到哪边。
lines.en: Wherever it circles, my head turns to match.
The flock presses behind me.

lines.zh: 它退开半步，我的眼睛不离开。
lines.en: It backs off half a step; my eyes never leave.
I push the lamb toward the middle.
There is no fence here.
My wool is too bright to hide.

lines.zh: 它一动，我整身的毛都绷起来。
lines.en: When it moves, every bit of my wool tightens.

lines.zh: 我把小羊数了一遍，再盯住它。
lines.en: I count the lambs once, then fix on it.

lines.zh: 我扯着嗓子叫，羊群往后退。
lines.en: I bleat loud and the flock backs away.
I shove once, with hardly any force.
That did not even bend the grass.
I rear and strike down with a hoof.

lines.zh: 我拿身子去撞，毛先碰到它。
lines.en: I charge with my body; my wool hits first.
This much strength — go ahead and laugh.
After the shove I run to the flock.
I bite your sleeve.
I was pushed into this.
After this blow, I withdraw.
I do not want to hurt anyone; I want to leave.

lines.zh: 我在平原上站起来，毛还湿着。
lines.en: I stand on the plains, wool still wet.

lines.zh: 一身颜色，在阳光里慢慢亮。
lines.en: My colors brighten slowly in the sun.
The ewe licks me nearby.
I shake, and the wool fluffs out.
This place is brighter than Earth's pasture.
My first taste of grass is sweet.
I try a few steps.
The flock comes to sniff me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看见很远的天。
lines.en: I raise my head and see a distant sky.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经有颜色了。
lines.en: My shadow already has color.

lines.zh: 我的毛烧起来了，很难扑灭。
lines.en: My wool catches fire and will not go out.
I fall with all four hooves in the air.

lines.zh: 毛吸满了水，我一直往下沉。
lines.en: My wool soaks up water and drags me down.
The blast lifts me and slams me down.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的毛边，带下一撮颜色。
lines.en: The arrow grazes my wool and carries off a tuft of color.
My colors scramble for an instant.

lines.zh: 饿得羊毛都塌了，我走不动。
lines.en: Hunger flattens my wool and I can barely walk.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我整只羊都僵了。
lines.en: The thunder freezes my whole body.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我一路往下。
lines.en: No ground below; I keep falling.
